title: Verify leader-check files against the cell's real commit diff
action: Per decision 5e3f0baf: make `bee cells leader-check` (record_leader_check in leader_check.rs) check the cell's trace.files_changed against the real git diff. (1) In leader_check.rs (NOT finish_support.rs — that file is held by another session's reservation; only READ it and reuse its pub(crate) COMMIT_TRAILER_WINDOW / cell_commit_trailer / commit_trailer_history_root), add `pub(crate) fn cell_commit_files(cwd: &Path, id: &str) -> Option<Vec<String>>`: scan the last COMMIT_TRAILER_WINDOW commits of cwd's HEAD (git log via crate::verbs::worktree::run_git, %H plus full %B body, NUL-separated like commit_trailer_present), pick every commit whose body has a line that trims to cell_commit_trailer(id), and return the union of their changed paths (git show --name-only --format= <hash>), each normalized with normalize_cell_path. Return None when git cannot run (non-zero exit / no repo); Some(vec![]) when no commit carries the trailer. (2) In record_leader_check, after the existing D3 checks and only when files_changed is non-empty: resolve the history root with commit_trailer_history_root(root, feature) (feature from the cell). None -> skip, entry field commit_diff = "skipped: git unavailable". Some(empty) -> if trace.commit_pending is a non-empty string, skip with commit_diff = "skipped: commit_pending"; else refuse: `recordLeaderCheck: cell "<id>" has no commit carrying the trailer "cell: <id>" in the last N commit(s) of <root> — files_changed cannot be verified against a real diff.` Some(paths) -> every normalized files_changed entry not in paths refuses: `recordLeaderCheck: cell "<id>" files_changed names path(s) the cell's commit(s) never touched: <list>.`; else commit_diff = "checked". (3) Write commit_diff onto each appended leader_check entry. Extra files in the diff that files_changed does not declare are NOT refused here. Keep the existing tests in leader_check.rs green (their tempdirs are not git repos, so they take the skip path). Add tests in leader_check.rs's tests module using a real git repo fixture (git init, config user, commits — copy the shape of commit_history_repo in cells/tests.rs): a claimed file present in the trailer commit passes with commit_diff checked; a claimed file absent from the trailer commit refuses naming it; no trailer commit refuses; no trailer commit plus trace.commit_pending passes with the skip value; a non-git root passes with the git-unavailable skip.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee leader_check

truths: leader-check refuses when a files_changed path is absent from the cell's trailer commit diff, naming the path
leader-check refuses when no commit carries the cell trailer and trace.commit_pending is unset
leader-check records commit_diff on every entry: checked, skipped: commit_pending, or skipped: git unavailable
